item.title: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Sunday, August 16th, 2026! It's a crisp 12°C out...
item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Sunday, August 16th, 2026! It's a crisp 12°C out there right now, mainly clear and feeling a touch cooler at 11°C, a perfect morning to ease into your Daily Drive playlist. With a high of 17°C later and a 100% chance of rain, definitely grab that umbrella before you head out today – remember, every drop of rain is just the earth refreshing itself, a reminder that new beginnings are always possible. So, let your playlist inspire you, make the most of this beautiful Sunday, and have a truly wonderful day!
